description: Pure operator input contract rejects unsafe or ambiguous key combinations
steps: Run the host input and event matrix tests
Verify repeat is limited to list/page navigation
Verify Back and long-OK safety transitions

description: Qualified fresh RF candidate preloads a bounded frequency-only carrier test with TX interlocks
steps: Run candidate validity, source, threshold, expiry, and cancellation tests
Run repeated TX lifecycle and refusal-state tests
Pass API scan and ufbt build

description: Every tab has useful browse or action controls and truthful visible prompts
steps: Verify per-tab short, long, and repeat event matrix
Verify sound and vibration are Settings-only
Audit every on-screen footer against its handler

description: Wi-Fi and BLE observations are browsable, identity-safe, and labeled without telemetry claims
steps: Run upstream-format parser and identity fixtures
Verify row browsing, age, count, channel, and source display
Verify no-observation and telemetry limitation language

description: A single-owner bounded recorder creates unique sessions and dumps with privacy and failure visibility
steps: Run codec, queue, unique-name, budget, privacy, and short-write fixtures
Verify worker and ISR paths enqueue without storage I/O
Pass API scan and ufbt build

description: GPS parsing has one owner per parser and exposes useful source and freshness pages
steps: Run NMEA and GPS source-state tests
Review producer synchronization
Pass ufbt build

description: Each recorded session can produce a plain-English summary of evidence and limitations
steps: Run deterministic report fixtures
Verify complete, incomplete, drop, storage, GPS privacy, and TX result language
Audit for unsupported capability claims

description: Info, Settings, and operator documentation agree with current source and upstream hardware behavior
steps: Audit all settings and controls against source
Verify BFFB GPS and Marauder command descriptions against pinned upstream source
Pass source-document consistency review

description: All local gates pass and a fresh FAP receipt is bound to the final commit
steps: Run every strict host test and API 87.1 scan
Run git diff check and fresh ufbt APPCHK
Record final commit, FAP SHA-256, size, and final read-only review
